footprintOutlineDefects.diagnosis: 该器件的封装内含 Board Outline 图形；原生 DRC 会把它和同一封装的焊盘比间距，产生永久违规。该对象不是层 11 的普通图元，按 id 删除后引擎会在保存/重载时重建，因此删除不是可靠修复。
recommendedFix: 换器件：sch replace --designator SW1 --lib <lib> --uuid <无内嵌 outline 的同类器件>，再同步 PCB
或换封装：sch rebind-footprint（同电气、不同 footprint）后重新同步
或改库：在封装编辑里删除该 Board Outline 图形（根因修复）
修复后必须 pcb save → doc reload → pcb drc 复验

evidence.drc: pcb drc output captured by the caller
evidence.note: delete-by-id was tested on this host: it reported success but the primitive was present again after save+reload, so the tool recommends a component/footprint-level fix instead of pretending to remove it
